faqs.q: Sec. 102-202.2. - Sewer system development charges—Residential facilities outside city.
faqs.a:
Sewer system development charges for serving residential facilities outside the corporate
               limits of the city, subject to
section 102-51
, are as follows:
(1)
An inspection fee of $37.50.
(2)
Sewer system development charges determined from the following schedule:
Type of Residence
Amount
Single-family
$12,480.00
Duplex
$8,740.00
Multifamily
$8,740.00
(3)
Plus, the Metro Water Recovery (formerly known as Metro Wastewater Reclamation District)
                  connector charge. The city acts as the agent for Metro Water Recovery in collection
                  of a connector charge in accordance with the fee schedule established by Metro Water
                  Recovery.
(4)
The sewer tap size required will be determined in accordance with the Uniform Plumbing
                  Code (UPC), as amended and adopted by the city.
(Ord. No.
4854
, § 13, 9-11-2023)
